overview: The NFDC Production Grants scheme is part of the Development, Communication and Dissemination of Filmic Content (DCDFC) scheme by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, under which NFDC produces and co-produces feature films, children's films, and documentary films in various Indian languages. It encourages debutant filmmakers by undertaking 100% production of their first feature film, children's film, and documentary film, and supports co-production of good quality films in partnership with filmmakers from India and abroad. The scheme aims to foster excellence in cinema, promote cultural diversity, and preserve India's cinematic heritage.
objectives: Encourage debutant filmmakers by undertaking 100% production of their first feature film, children's film, and documentary film
Support co-production of good quality films in partnership with filmmakers from India and abroad
Foster excellence in cinema and promote the diversity of Indian culture
Preserve the rich heritage of filmic content and ensure its wider reach within and across borders
Develop talent and facilitate the growth of Indian cinema in all languages through productions and co-productions
Promote Indian culture through cinema in India and overseas
Build a lean and flexible organization responsive to the needs of the Indian film industry
eligibility: Under the DCDFC scheme, NFDC produces & co-produces films, children's films and documentaries under its extant guidelines for production, whereby it encourages debutant filmmakers by undertaking 100% production of their first Feature Film, Children’s Film and Documentary Film and Co-production of good quality films in partnership with filmmakers both from India and abroad.
benefits: 100% production support for debut feature films, children's films, and documentary films; co-production opportunities with Indian and international filmmakers; access to NFDC's production guidelines and expertise; participation in Film Bazaar and other NFDC initiatives for global exposure; preservation and promotion of India's cinematic heritage.
financial_support: NFDC provides 100% financial support for the production of debut feature films, children's films, and documentary films under the DCDFC scheme, and co-produces good quality films in partnership with filmmakers from India and abroad, with funding sourced from the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting's Development, Communication and Dissemination of Filmic Content scheme.
grant_amount_per_entity: 100% production cost for debut feature films, children's films, and documentary films
application_process: 1. Apply through government-supported film festivals such as IFFI (Goa), Mumbai International Film Festival, Film Bazaar, etc. 2. Submit feature, documentary, animation projects, etc. for consideration. 3. NFDC evaluates submissions under the DCDFC scheme. 4. Selected projects receive 100% production support or co-production opportunities. 5. Follow NFDC's extant production guidelines for execution.
caveats: Funding is subject to the guidelines of the Development, Communication and Dissemination of Filmic Content (DCDFC) scheme
Projects must align with NFDC's production guidelines and objectives
Support is contingent on submission through government-supported film festivals
